title: 2023年3月 第1套

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Thanks for inviting me out tonight.
lines.translation: M：谢谢你今晚邀请我出来。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: I've been wanting to try this place for weeks.
lines.translation: 我一直想来这家店试试，已经好几个星期了。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: I usually pass it on my way home from work but never seem to have time to stop.
lines.translation: 我通常下班回家的路上会经过这里，但似乎总是没时间停下来。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: I've been dying to come here as well.
lines.translation: W：我也一直特别想来这里。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: I was worried that the menu might not be accommodating.
lines.translation: 我当时还担心菜单可能不太适合不同的饮食需求。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: But one of my close friends ate here last week.
lines.translation: 不过，我有一位好朋友上周来这里吃过饭。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: She's a vegetarian.
lines.translation: 她是素食者。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: She told me that there were a lot of options for her, and they offered alternative dishes.
lines.translation: 她告诉我，这里有很多适合她的选择，而且他们还会提供替代菜品。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: But you're not vegetarian, are you?
lines.translation: M：不过你不是素食者，对吧？

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Well, not entirely.
lines.translation: W：嗯，也不完全是。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: I don't eat meat at all, but I don't have a problem eating fish, seafood or eggs.
lines.translation: 我一点肉都不吃，但鱼、海鲜和鸡蛋我都可以吃。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Isn't that very difficult?
lines.translation: M：这不是很难吗？

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: I can't imagine giving up a premium juicy steak or bacon cheeseburgers.
lines.translation: 我无法想象放弃上等的多汁牛排或培根芝士汉堡。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: I wouldn't know.
lines.translation: W：我也不知道。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: My parents followed the same diet.
lines.translation: 我父母遵循的也是同样的饮食习惯。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Even when I was younger, we never had meat during meals, and I never really had a craving to try it.
lines.translation: 甚至在我小的时候，我们吃饭时也从来不吃肉，而我也从来没有特别想尝试。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: I bet it would be hard though, giving up something you're accustomed to eating.
lines.translation: 话说回来，放弃一种你已经习惯吃的东西，肯定会很难。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: I tried cutting back on coffee in the morning, and it was awful.
lines.translation: 我试过早上少喝咖啡，感觉糟透了。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Come to think of it, it was probably even worse for my colleagues that had to deal with me at morning meetings.
lines.translation: 现在想想，那段时间可能对我的同事来说更糟，因为他们得在早会上应付我。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: That's even harder to imagine you, without coffee.
lines.translation: M：我更难想象没有咖啡的你。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: So you say your parents also followed a partially vegetarian diet?
lines.translation: 你是说你父母也遵循半素食饮食？

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Why did they decide to do that?
lines.translation: 他们为什么决定这样做？

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: That's an interesting question.
lines.translation: W：这是个有意思的问题。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: I never thought to ask them though.
lines.translation: 不过我从来没想过要问他们。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: My best guess is for health reasons.
lines.translation: 我的最大猜测是出于健康原因。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: They're not terribly active or knowledgeable about animal preservation efforts, but they're serious about their health.
lines.translation: 他们并不是特别活跃，也不太了解动物保护方面的工作，但他们非常重视自己的健康。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Both are in their 70s now, but eat organic as often as possible and take part in regular physical exercise.
lines.translation: 他们现在都七十多岁了，却尽可能经常吃有机食品，还定期参加体育锻炼。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Neither of them has any health problems, and they hardly ever get sick.
lines.translation: 他们俩都没有任何健康问题，而且几乎从来不会生病。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: In that case, I might give it a try someday.
lines.translation: M：这样的话，也许哪天我会试试看。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Now back to the menu.
lines.translation: W：现在回到菜单上来。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: What are you going to have?
lines.translation: 你打算吃什么？

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Questions 1-4 are based on the conversation you have just heard.
lines.translation: 问题1 -4是基于你刚才听到的谈话

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 1. Where does the conversation most probably take place?
lines.translation: 第 1 题：对话最可能发生在哪里?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 2. What do we learn about the woman?
lines.translation: 第 2 题：关于这位女士我们了解到什么?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 3. What would be a difficult thing to do according to the woman?
lines.translation: 第 3 题：根据这位女士的说法,什么事情会比较难做到?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 4. What does the woman say about her parents?
lines.translation: 第 4 题：这位女士关于她父母说了什么?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Conversation 2.
lines.translation: 对话2。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: How did your annual performance evaluation meeting with your manager go?
lines.translation: 你和经理的年度绩效评估会议进行得怎么样？

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Did you get much in the way of praise?
lines.translation: 他有没有怎么表扬你？

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Next to zero.
lines.translation: 几乎没有。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: When we came to the part about discussing my areas for growth, he bluntly told me that I had an attitude problem.
lines.translation: 谈到讨论我需要改进的方面时，他直截了当地告诉我，我的态度有问题。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: But he wouldn't really expand on that description.
lines.translation: 但他并没有进一步解释这个说法。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: He said it's the little things I do and say.
lines.translation: 他说，是我做的一些小事和说的一些话造成的。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Did you ask him for a specific example?
lines.translation: 你有没有让他举个具体的例子？

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: I did ask him a few more questions to try and narrow it down.
lines.translation: 我确实又问了几个问题，想把范围缩小一些。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: He said my constant questioning of him and his decisions was the most obvious example he could give.
lines.translation: 他说，我不断质疑他和他的决定，就是他能举出的最明显的例子。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Then our conversation was swiftly brought to a close.
lines.translation: 然后我们的谈话很快就结束了。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: I had a similar experience once.
lines.translation: 我以前也有过类似的经历。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: My manager told me I was too honest.
lines.translation: 我的经理说我太诚实了。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: In most cases, I thought my honesty was helpful, as did my colleagues, but my manager thought otherwise.
lines.translation: 大多数情况下，我觉得我的诚实是有帮助的，我的同事也这么认为，但我的经理却不这么想。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Some managers really adopt manipulative language to disguise the unreasonable choices they have made.
lines.translation: 有些经理确实会采用操纵性的语言，来掩饰他们做出的不合理选择。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: They don't use the rational power of arguments to resolve issues of conflict or complaints about unfairness.
lines.translation: 他们不会运用论证的理性力量，来解决冲突问题或人们对不公平的抱怨。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Right.
lines.translation: 没错。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Some employ their persuasive vocabulary and influential communication style to win workplace arguments by compelling people to perform the intended action.
lines.translation: 有些人会运用有说服力的词汇和具有影响力的沟通方式，通过迫使人们采取预期的行动来赢得职场争论。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Exactly.
lines.translation: 正是。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Too honest?
lines.translation: 太诚实了？

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Isn't that a good thing?
lines.translation: 这难道不是一件好事吗？

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: I thought that's surely something we should have covered earlier in the section discussing strengths and talents, but no.
lines.translation: 我本以为这肯定是我们早些时候在讨论优势和才能的部分应该涉及的内容，但事实并非如此。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Honesty was deemed to be more of a sin than a virtue, since it made people feel uncomfortable, or at least it made the most powerful folks feel uncomfortable.
lines.translation: 诚实被认为更像是一种罪过，而不是一种美德，因为它让人感到不自在，或者至少让那些最有权势的人感到不自在。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Indeed.
lines.translation: 的确如此。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Rhetoric is viewed by many philosophers as the method through which the powerful accumulate more power.
lines.translation: 许多哲学家认为，修辞是有权势者积累更多权力的手段。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: By virtue of having the loudest voice, they're able to command greater attention and to further assert their dominance, even when what they're saying doesn't really make much sense.
lines.translation: 凭借最大的声音，他们能够获得更多关注，并进一步巩固自己的支配地位，即使他们所说的话其实没什么道理。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: And retaining their power and prestige is their priority.
lines.translation: 而保住他们的权力和声望才是他们的首要任务。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: It's what makes the most sense to a lot of them.
lines.translation: 对很多人来说，这才是最合理的做法。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Questions 5 to 8 are based on the conversation you have just heard.
lines.translation: 问题5到8是基于你刚才听到的谈话

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 5. What was the manager's reason for giving little praise for the man's performance?
lines.translation: 第 5 题：经理对这名男士的工作表现几乎不予赞扬的原因是什么?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 6. What does the woman say about some managers?
lines.translation: 第 6 题：女士对一些管理者有什么看法?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 7. According to the woman, what do some managers think of honesty?
lines.translation: 第 7 题：根据女士的说法,一些管理者如何看待诚实?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 8. What does the woman think is the priority of many managers?
lines.translation: 第 8 题：女士认为许多管理者的首要任务是什么?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: B. In this section, you will hear two passages.
lines.translation: B. 在本节中,你将听到两段。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: At the end of each passage, you will hear three or four questions.
lines.translation: 在每一段的结尾,你将听到三四个问题。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Both the passage and the questions will be spoken only once.
lines.translation: 发言的通过和提问将只讲一次。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: After you hear a question,
lines.translation: 在你听到一个问题之后

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: You must choose the best answer from the four choices marked A, B,
lines.translation: 你必须从四个选择中选择最好的答案 标注A,B,

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: C, D.
lines.translation: C, D. , C, D. , C.

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: mark the corresponding letter on answer sheet one with a single line through the center.
lines.translation: 在答题单单行的答题表一中标出相应的字母。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Passage one.
lines.translation: 一号通道

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Athletes are seen as heroes because they can do things that most of us can't do.
lines.translation: 运动员被视为英雄，是因为他们能做到我们大多数人做不到的事情。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: They can hit fastballs coming at them at nearly 100 miles an hour, and leap and hang in the air, seemingly defying gravity.
lines.translation: 他们能击中以接近每小时100英里的速度飞向他们的快速球，还能跃起并悬停在空中，似乎在对抗重力。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: They get paid millions of dollars for their efforts, and their names and faces appear on everything from running shoes to advertising boards.
lines.translation: 他们因自己的努力而获得数百万美元的报酬，他们的名字和面孔出现在从跑鞋到广告牌的各种物品上。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Athletes who are champions also show qualities such as perseverance, dedication, and the ability to keep their cool under pressure.
lines.translation: 成为冠军的运动员还展现出诸如毅力、奉献以及在压力下保持冷静的能力等品质。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Many show those same qualities off the playing field, too.
lines.translation: 许多人在赛场之外也展现出相同的品质。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Stories about superstar athletes teach us about working hard and believing in ourselves and then being passionate about what we do.
lines.translation: 关于超级巨星运动员的故事教导我们要努力拼搏、相信自己，并对自己所做的事情充满热情。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Although it's usually bad behavior that gets an athlete a spot on the six o'clock news, many high-profile players work hard to be positive role models to children.
lines.translation: 尽管通常是不良行为让运动员登上六点钟新闻，但许多备受关注的球员仍努力成为孩子们积极的榜样。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: They raise money for charities and act as mentors, talking to student groups and volunteering their time to programs that help children keep off drugs and stay in school.
lines.translation: 他们为慈善机构筹集资金并担任导师，与学生群体交流，并志愿为帮助儿童远离毒品和留在学校的项目奉献时间。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Still, even the greatest champions have flaws.
lines.translation: 即使是最伟大的冠军也有缺点

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Just because an athlete has the perfect golf swing doesn't mean he is the perfect parent, friend or spokesperson.
lines.translation: 仅仅因为运动员有完美的高尔夫秋千 并不意味着他是完美的父母 朋友或发言人

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: They also make mistakes.
lines.translation: 他们也犯错

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Separating an athlete's professional and personal lives can be tough.
lines.translation: 将运动员的职业和个人生活分开可能很困难。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: When a sports star gets in trouble with the law, or does something wrong in their private life, fans are often left disappointed.
lines.translation: 当体育明星遇到法律麻烦或私生活有问题时,

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Before he died, baseball star Mickey Mantle, who was plagued with alcohol problems, told young ballplayers and the fans who admired him "to play like me, don't be like me."
lines.translation: 在他死前,棒球明星米奇·曼托尔, 身陷酒精问题, 告诉年轻球员和崇拜他的球迷们, “要像我一样演奏,不要像我一样。”

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Questions 9-11 are based on the passage you have just heard.
lines.translation: 问题9 -11是基于你刚才听到的段落

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 9. Why does the speaker say athletes are often viewed as heroes?
lines.translation: 第 9 题：为什么说话者说运动员常被视为英雄？

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 10. What does the speaker say many high-profile players do?
lines.translation: 第 10 题：说话者说许多知名球员会做什么？

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 11. What does the speaker say can be difficult?
lines.translation: 第 11 题：说话者说什么可能很困难？

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: We don't need to tell you that weddings can get expensive.
lines.translation: 我们无需告诉你，婚礼可能会变得非常昂贵。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Even with the most meticulous budgeting, a few unexpected costs are bound to occur.
lines.translation: 即使预算安排得最为周密，也必然会出现一些意料之外的开支。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: While most brides tend to accept this as fact, one Canadian woman, who is only known as Susan, attempted to avoid all wedding costs.
lines.translation: 大多数新娘往往会接受这一事实，但一名仅以 Susan 为人所知的加拿大女子却试图避开所有婚礼费用。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: She did this by asking her friends and family to pay up to attend her wedding.
lines.translation: 她要求亲朋好友付费参加自己的婚礼。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: It went about as well as you'd expect.
lines.translation: 结果正如你所料，事情进展得相当不顺利。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Susan is causing quite the debate online after posting a bizarre Facebook complaint about her now-cancelled wedding.
lines.translation: Susan 在 Facebook 上发布了一篇抱怨她那场如今已经取消的婚礼的奇怪帖子后，在网上引发了激烈争论。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Yes, the couple called off the wedding just days before their wedding vows.
lines.translation: 没错，这对情侣在交换结婚誓言前几天取消了婚礼。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Since their guests refused to pay the $1,500 attendance fee, the $60,000 dream wedding was put on permanent hold.
lines.translation: 由于宾客拒绝支付 1,500 美元的参加费用，这场价值 60,000 美元的梦幻婚礼被无限期搁置。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: In her long explanation filled with cursing and swearing, the bride accused her friends and family of ruining her marriage and her life.
lines.translation: 在那篇充斥着咒骂和脏话的长篇解释中，新娘指责亲朋好友毁掉了她的婚姻和人生。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: She stated that each guest would only need to pay $1,500 while she sacrificed everything for the day.
lines.translation: 她表示，每位宾客只需支付 1,500 美元，而她为了这一天牺牲了一切。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Her maid of honor told her to stick to the budget, as she was asking too much from her guests.
lines.translation: 她的伴娘告诉她要遵守预算，因为她向宾客索要的费用太高了。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: But Susan ignored her.
lines.translation: 但 Susan 没有理会她。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Not surprisingly, only eight people responded positively to the wedding invitations and money requests.
lines.translation: 毫不意外，只有八个人对婚礼邀请和付款请求作出了积极回应。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Realizing they would not be able to afford their dream wedding, Susan's future husband suggested getting married in Las Vegas.
lines.translation: 意识到他们将无法负担梦幻婚礼后，Susan 的未婚夫建议去拉斯维加斯结婚。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The bride quickly shut down the idea, saying she did not want a wedding of gambling and heavy drinking.
lines.translation: 新娘很快否决了这个想法，称她不想要一场充斥着赌博和酗酒的婚礼。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: It seems her dream wedding has now become a nightmare.
lines.translation: 看来，她的梦幻婚礼如今已经变成了一场噩梦。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 12. What does the speaker say about weddings?
lines.translation: 第 12 题：说话者关于婚礼说了什么?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 13. What do we learn about the wedding of the Canadian woman Susan?
lines.translation: 第 13 题：关于加拿大女性Susan的婚礼,我们了解到什么?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 14. What did Susan's maid of honor advise her to do?
lines.translation: 第 14 题：Susan的伴娘建议她做什么?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 15. How did Susan respond to her future husband's suggestion?
lines.translation: 第 15 题：Susan如何回应她未婚夫的建议?

lines.translation: 记录一。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: It has long been scientifically established that weather changes can affect people's moods.
lines.translation: 天气变化会影响人的情绪，这一点早已得到科学证实。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Now, a new study has provided evidence that temperature can influence people's personalities.
lines.translation: 如今，一项新的研究提供了温度能够影响人们性格的证据。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: This study of over 1.6 million people revealed that 22 degrees Celsius is the perfect air temperature to live in.
lines.translation: 这项针对超过160万人的研究显示，22摄氏度是最适合居住的空气温度。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: A city with an average annual temperature closer to 22 tends to have a population who are more agreeable, conscientious, emotionally stable, and outgoing.
lines.translation: 年平均气温更接近22摄氏度的城市，其居民往往更加随和、尽责、情绪稳定且外向。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: It is the least taxing temperature for the body to regulate its own temperature.
lines.translation: 这是人体调节自身温度时负担最小的温度。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The study was observational and didn't show cause and effect, but the scientists behind it theorized that better weather leads people to leave their home more often.
lines.translation: 这项研究属于观察性研究，并未证明因果关系，但研究背后的科学家推测，更宜人的天气会使人们更频繁地外出。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: This, in turn, leads to more social interaction, which encourages them to develop a friendlier and socially more acceptable personality.
lines.translation: 这样一来，人们会有更多的社交互动，从而促使他们形成更加友善、在社交方面更容易被接受的性格。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Warmer climates also make people feel more positive in general.
lines.translation: 较温暖的气候通常也会让人们更加积极乐观。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: They tend to be more agreeable and conscientious.
lines.translation: 他们往往更加随和、尽责。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The findings might help explain why colder and warmer countries tend to produce people with different personalities.
lines.translation: 这些发现或许有助于解释为什么较寒冷和较温暖的国家往往会孕育出性格不同的人。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Roughly speaking, about 40% of a person's personality is determined by their genes, the other 60% by their environment.
lines.translation: 大致来说，一个人的性格约有40%由基因决定，另外60%由环境决定。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: It was already well-known that personality traits vary across geographic regions.
lines.translation: 众所周知，性格特征在不同地理区域之间存在差异。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Scientists also knew that these geographic personality traits are associated with a broad range of consequential outcomes.
lines.translation: 科学家们还知道，这些与地理区域相关的性格特征与广泛的重要结果有关。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: These outcomes include economic activity, for example, entrepreneurial start-up rates, and also crime rates, health behaviors, and health outcomes.
lines.translation: 这些结果包括经济活动，例如创业企业的初创率，也包括犯罪率、健康行为和健康状况。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: And it is well established that personality traits differ between countries.
lines.translation: 此外，不同国家之间的性格特征存在差异，这一点也已得到充分证实。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The research team speculated the two might be linked.
lines.translation: 研究团队推测，这两者可能存在联系。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: To test this, they gave online personality tests to 5,587 Chinese students and 1.66 million Americans.
lines.translation: 为了检验这一点，他们对5587名中国学生和166万名美国人进行了在线性格测试。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: They then compared the results with the average annual temperature where they grew up.
lines.translation: 随后，他们将测试结果与这些人长大所在地的年平均气温进行了比较。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The tests measured personality along five well-studied characteristics.
lines.translation: 这些测试依据五项经过充分研究的特征来衡量性格。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The five were agreeability, conscientiousness, emotional stability, outgoingness, and openness to new experiences.
lines.translation: 这五项特征分别是随和性、尽责性、情绪稳定性、外向性以及对新体验的开放性。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: In both groups, the researchers found the closer a town's average annual temperature was to 22 degrees, the more its population exhibited those personality characteristics.
lines.translation: 在两组人群中，研究人员都发现，一个城镇的年平均气温越接近22摄氏度，其居民越明显地表现出这些性格特征。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: However, the findings were much stronger for the Chinese group than the Americans studied, which suggests that though temperature plays a role, it does not play a dominant role.
lines.translation: 然而，这些发现对中国群体的解释力远强于对所研究的美国人的解释力，这表明尽管温度确实发挥作用，但并非起主导作用。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The effects are fairly weak.
lines.translation: 其影响相当微弱。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: It's unlikely to lead to many arguments over the temperature setting of the office air conditioner.
lines.translation: 因此，温度设定不太可能引发许多关于办公室空调温度的争论。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Question 16 to 18 are based on the recording you have just heard.
lines.translation: 问题16至18是基于你刚才听到的录音。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 16. What has a new study revealed about temperature?
lines.translation: 第 16 题：一项新研究揭示了关于温度的什么信息?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 17. What does the speaker say about warmer climates?
lines.translation: 第 17 题：说话者关于较温暖的气候说了什么?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 18. What did the online personality tests suggest?
lines.translation: 第 18 题：在线性格测试表明了什么?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 2. Today, we're talking about loneliness.
lines.translation: 今天,我们谈论的是孤独

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Loneliness and social isolation are growing public health concerns for people of all ages in the United States, from adolescence to the elderly.
lines.translation: 对于美国各个年龄段的人来说，从青少年到老年人，孤独和社会隔离正日益成为令人担忧的公共卫生问题。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Public health experts are worried because loneliness seems to be on the rise, and studies have long found correlations between loneliness and an assortment of medical conditions that threaten health and longevity.
lines.translation: 公共卫生专家对此感到担忧，是因为孤独似乎正在增加，而研究长期以来一直发现，孤独与一系列威胁健康和长寿的疾病之间存在相关性。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The problem of loneliness may be even greater than we thought.
lines.translation: 孤独问题可能比我们想象的还要严重。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: A new national poll found that about a third of older Americans are lonely, and almost as many seniors feel isolated.
lines.translation: 一项新的全国性民意调查发现，大约三分之一的美国老年人感到孤独，几乎同样多的老年人感到与社会隔绝。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: This is a serious problem as research shows that chronic loneliness is particularly harmful to senior citizens.
lines.translation: 研究表明，长期孤独对老年人尤其有害，因此这是一个严重的问题。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: That's because it can impair older adults' memory and damage their physical and mental health.
lines.translation: 这是因为孤独会损害老年人的记忆，并危害他们的身体和心理健康。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Chronic loneliness even impacts the life expectancy of seniors, increasing their risk of early mortality.
lines.translation: 长期孤独甚至会影响老年人的预期寿命，增加他们过早死亡的风险。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Let's take a closer look at that poll now.
lines.translation: 现在，让我们进一步了解这项民意调查。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: More than a third of seniors in the poll said they felt lonely at least some of the time, and 27% said they sometimes or often felt isolated.
lines.translation: 调查中超过三分之一的老年人表示，他们至少有一部分时间感到孤独，27%的人表示自己有时或经常感到与社会隔绝。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: This reflects how much time the seniors spent with others.
lines.translation: 这反映了老年人与他人相处的时间。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Almost 30% said they socialized with friends, family or neighbors once a week or less.
lines.translation: 近30%的人表示，他们每周与朋友、家人或邻居社交的次数不超过一次。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Women were more likely than men to report loneliness.
lines.translation: 女性报告感到孤独的可能性高于男性。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: But there is good news.
lines.translation: 但也有好消息。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: It looks like loneliness can be reversed.
lines.translation: 看来孤独是可以得到改善的。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: But researchers are still trying to determine the best way to do so.
lines.translation: 不过，研究人员仍在努力确定最佳方法。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Why is that?
lines.translation: 为什么会这样呢？

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Resolving the problem of loneliness among seniors often isn't as simple as getting them together with others or moving them in with their children.
lines.translation: 解决老年人的孤独问题，往往并不像让他们与他人聚在一起或让他们搬去和子女同住那么简单。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: In fact, the poll found that seniors who lived with their children were more likely to report feeling lonely than those who didn't.
lines.translation: 事实上，调查发现，与子女同住的老年人比不与子女同住的老年人更有可能报告自己感到孤独。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: This may be because loneliness refers to the discrepancy between actual and desired relationships.
lines.translation: 这可能是因为，孤独指的是实际关系与期望关系之间的差距。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: So it's possible that someone who lives alone doesn't meet that definition, while someone in a house full of busy people does.
lines.translation: 因此，一个独居的人可能不符合这一定义，而一个住在满是忙碌人群的房子里的人却可能符合。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: How can we solve the problem?
lines.translation: 我们该如何解决这个问题呢？

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Well, the researchers assert that it's important to address each person's underlying cause of loneliness, whether it's the death of a spouse, medical problems, or social expectations that haven't been fulfilled.
lines.translation: 研究人员认为，重要的是要解决每个人孤独感背后的根本原因，无论是配偶去世、健康问题，还是未能满足的社会期望。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: It's noteworthy that there is one general recommendation.
lines.translation: 值得注意的是，有一条普遍建议。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: While finding solutions for loneliness is highly personal, research suggests the best interventions are those that involve meaningful social contact at least once a week.
lines.translation: 虽然寻找孤独问题的解决方案高度因人而异，但研究表明，最佳干预措施是至少每周进行一次有意义的社会接触。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Depending on the person, that could mean volunteering, seeing an old friend or something else.
lines.translation: 根据个人情况，这可能意味着参加志愿活动、去见一位老朋友，或者采取其他方式。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 19. Why does the speaker say the finding of a new national poll reveals a serious problem?
lines.translation: 第 19 题：为什么说话者说一项新的全国民意调查的发现揭示了一个严重的问题?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 20. What is the good news the speaker talks about?
lines.translation: 第 20 题：说话者谈到的好消息是什么?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 21. What is the key to solving the loneliness problem according to the speaker?
lines.translation: 第 21 题：根据说话者的说法,解决孤独问题的关键是什么?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Recording three Hello,
lines.translation: 记录3 你好

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Hello, I'm co-founder of the popular female travel community We Are Travel Girls.
lines.translation: 你好,我是流行女性旅行社的 共同创始人 我们是旅行女郎

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: We collect and publish stories from women traveling all over the world.
lines.translation: 我们收集并出版世界各地妇女旅游的报道。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: We promote women's blogs; we host meetings and events and are getting ready to launch our Travel With Us trips in Bali, Japan and Malawi.
lines.translation: 我们提倡妇女博客;我们主办各种会议和活动,并准备在巴厘、日本和马拉维发起我们的旅行旅行。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Before I started We Are Travel Girls, I had a successful 10-year career in finance in London, where I advised private clients on their investments.
lines.translation: 在创办 We Are Travel Girls 之前，我在伦敦的金融行业拥有一份成功的十年职业生涯，为私人客户提供投资方面的建议。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Having always had a huge love for travel, I finally took the leap and left finance to pursue my dream of starting a travel company.
lines.translation: 我一直非常热爱旅行，最终毅然离开金融行业，追寻创办一家旅行公司的梦想。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: For as long as I can remember, I wanted to be a travel writer.
lines.translation: 从我记事起，我就想成为一名旅行作家。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Before blogs existed and everything we read was online, I would go to travel writing seminars by writers who were published in travel magazines.
lines.translation: 在博客尚未出现、我们阅读的所有内容都还是在线下的时候，我会参加由那些在旅行杂志上发表过作品的作家举办的旅行写作研讨会。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: I was desperate to write for one of those magazines, but didn't know how to break into that industry.
lines.translation: 我非常渴望为其中一本杂志撰稿，却不知道该如何进入那个行业。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: After university, I ended up working in finance, but always had a desire to travel and write about it.
lines.translation: 大学毕业后，我最终进入了金融行业工作，但始终渴望去旅行并写下旅行见闻。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: In 2015, I was looking at ways to leave finance, and my best friend Vanessa, who grew up on a ranch on the Central Coast of California, suggested starting a blog.
lines.translation: 2015年，我正在寻找离开金融行业的方法，我最好的朋友 Vanessa 从小在加利福尼亚州中部海岸的一座牧场长大，她建议我们创办一个博客。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: But when we started creating it, we realized that was the same thing every girl was doing.
lines.translation: 但当我们开始创建博客时，我们意识到，这正是每个女孩都在做的事情。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: So we turned our attention to creating a community among these women.
lines.translation: 于是，我们把注意力转向在这些女性之间建立一个社区。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: This led us to start We Are Travel Girls, which has now grown into a community of over 200,000 followers.
lines.translation: 这促使我们创办了 We Are Travel Girls，如今它已经发展成为一个拥有超过20万名关注者的社区。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: To anyone thinking about becoming a travel writer, I would suggest they first try and look for a unique way to enter the industry.
lines.translation: 对于任何考虑成为旅行作家的人，我建议他们首先尝试寻找一种独特的方式进入这个行业。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: There are a lot of travel writers now and it can be hard to stand out from the crowd, which is really why we started We Are Travel Girls.
lines.translation: 如今旅行作家很多，要在人群中脱颖而出可能很难，这正是我们创办 We Are Travel Girls 的原因。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Be prepared to work hard if you want to turn it into a full-time business, and try not to rush to selling advertising spaces before you have created a dedicated audience.
lines.translation: 若想把它发展成一项全职事业，就要做好努力工作的准备，并且在建立起一批忠实的受众之前，不要急于出售广告位。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The size of your audience doesn't necessarily need to be huge, but you want them to be engaged.
lines.translation: 你的受众规模不一定要非常庞大，但你希望他们积极参与。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: If you post too many promotions early on, you will turn many people off.
lines.translation: 如果一开始就发布太多推广内容，会让许多人失去兴趣。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 22. What do we learn about the speaker before she created the community We Are Travel Girls?
lines.translation: 第 22 题：在创建 We Are Travel Girls 社区之前,我们对说话者有什么了解?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 23. What did the speaker's friend suggest they do in 2015?
lines.translation: 第 23 题：说话者的朋友在2015年建议她们做什么?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 24. What does the speaker advise people to do if they want to become travel writers?
lines.translation: 第 24 题：如果人们想成为旅行作家,说话者建议他们做什么?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 25. What is the speaker's advice on winning a loyal audience?
lines.translation: 第 25 题：关于赢得忠实受众,说话者的建议是什么?
